recommendations.speaker: Georg Attling
recommendations.reasoning: Evolution trades at 12x forward EV/EBITDA, a level only seen once historically (Oct 23) after which stock rose 40% in a couple of months. The company has 70% margins and ~20% growth. We believe the declining growth trend has bottomed and will accelerate in the second half. Margins should improve as the headcount catch-up is done. USA long-term opportunity remains with low penetration, and Asia provides growth despite regulatory uncertainty. Attractive setup with accelerating growth and improving margins trading near all-time low multiples.
recommendations.quote: Det är det här stor del varför vi tycker att det är så intressant nu. Det är att du är nere på 12 gånger framåtplicken dbda. Det har det varit en gång tidigare historiskt. recommendations.speaker: Georg Attling
recommendations.reasoning: Monopoly/near-monopoly position in Swedish real estate advertising with exceptional pricing power. Annual revenue per listing increased 33% from 2018-2023, from 0 to ~5,000 SEK, and this pricing journey is far from over compared to peers like REA Group which charge 2-3x more. Strong 2024 recovery in listing volume should drive growth acceleration, especially in Q2. Broker incentive changes in July will incentivize selling higher-priced packages. Potential for margin expansion as broker commission decreases over time. Position for rest of year as Q2 expected to be very strong.
recommendations.quote: Vi lyfter fram det som ett av våra favoriter. Och det är väl anledningen varför vi lyfter fram det som ett av våra favoriter. Vi tror Q2 blir väldigt stark och bra aktie att positionera sig i resten av året.

recommendations.speaker: Georg Attling
recommendations.reasoning: Best company on Stockholm Stock Exchange with exceptional track record: 20x revenue growth over 10 years with margin expansion and maintained strong growth. Average revenue per customer only 300 SEK/month with 30% price increase over 3 years and more room to raise. Product penetration low: most customers use bookkeeping but only 25-30% use invoicing, even less for financing products. Financing products are higher-priced and data advantages enable better risk assessment. Customer acquisition stable at 50-55k annually despite tougher economy. Valuation appears cheap compared to global peers with similar growth profiles and historical multiples.

Och likaså om man bara tittar på vad bolaget brukar handlas på för multiplar så är nuvarande nivåer inte särskilt aggressiva. Så vidare om man kan bibehålla bra tillväxt och fortsätta driva lite marginal så tycker vi att det här är billigt.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Evolution has underperformed with -7% YTD and -30% vs index over last year as growth has slowed. Six quarters of declining growth, especially in Live, driven by challenges in USA where regulatory structure limits scalability, and weaker Latam before Brazil regulation. Margins hit 70% but Q1 saw unusual pressure from headcount buildup (+15% in 2 quarters). Georgia geopolitical risk with 40% of employees. Despite challenges, Georg believes the growth deceleration has bottomed and will accelerate. Trading at 12x forward EV/EBITDA, a level only seen once historically (Oct 23) before a 40% rally. USA still offers long-term low penetration opportunity despite slow rollout. Asia provides growth but with regulatory risk and lower multiples.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Hemnet has near-monopoly position in Swedish real estate advertising with exceptional pricing power. Average price per listing increased from free to 5,000 SEK over 10 years. Annual revenue per listing up 33% from 2018-2023, but Georg believes pricing journey far from over compared to international peers like REA Group which charge 2-3x more. Q4 2023 saw boosted metrics due to listing time lengthening and revenue recognition effect, causing Q1 2024 disappointment. Underlying Q1 showed acceleration from Q4. 2024 showing strong recovery in listing volume, especially for Q2. New pay-later model (pay when sold) launched October with 50% penetration and +10% pricing, driving 5% growth at 100% margin. Upgraded packages penetration increased from 30% in Q4-21 to 50% in 2023 (compared to almost all upgraded at REA Group). July broker incentive change incentivizes selling higher-priced packages. Long-term margin potential from reducing broker kickback from current 28% of ad revenue. Bolid mentioned as potential threat but Georg sees state-owned SBAB as 'good competition' and Bolid's purpose is driving loans, not competing.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Fortnox is one of the best companies on Stockholm Stock Exchange with exceptional track record: 20x revenue growth over 10 years with margin expansion and maintained strong growth. Revenue still growing via both average revenue per customer and customer acquisition. Average revenue per customer only 300 SEK/month with 30% price increase over 3 years and more room to raise. Product penetration low: most customers use bookkeeping but only 25-30% use invoicing, even less for other products. Financing products (factoring, small loans) are highest-priced and Fortnox has data advantage for risk assessment since they can see both buyer and seller. Customer acquisition stable at 50-55k annually despite tougher economy. Financial Times has questioned addressable market size and definition changes, but Georg finds this normal and sees 1.5 million addressable customers as possibly high but reasonable for debate. Valuation appears expensive but cheap compared to global peers with similar growth profiles and vs historical multiples. Risk is if growth decelerates significantly, then historical multiples no longer apply.
